Minecraft Dungeons II – Gameplay Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Minecraft Dungeons II arrives September 29, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch! Pre-order now and get the exclusive Twisted cape, Twisted Chicken pet, and two hero skins: https://ninten.do/6007aOYUF

Mysterious rifts are opening across the Overworld! They lead to the Sift, a new dimension coming in Minecraft Dungeons II. Gear up and team up to journey into uncharted lands and face threats unlike anything you've fought before. Discover new ways to customize your loadout and playstyle as you prepare for your toughest battle yet. Do you have what it takes to brave the Sift? 

#Minecraft #DungeonsII

Stellar Blade Complete Edition – Action Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Become humanity’s last hope in Stellar Blade Complete Edition, releasing on Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026!  

You are EVE, an elite warrior sent to reclaim Earth from mysterious forces. Are you up to the challenge? 

This story-driven action-adventure features fast-paced combat built around dodging, parrying, and unleashing powerful combo attacks, alongside cinematic exploration and intense boss encounters. 

Experience EVE’s journey at home or on the go, and enjoy all-new Joy-Con 2 support for features such as fishing!
